objective: Generate synthetic single-cell RNA-seq profiles for exploratory analysis.
rationale: Explicit synthesis objective; sparse raw counts support a negative-binomial latent model. Exploratory plausibility must be evaluated, not assumed.
success_criteria: Finite nonnegative integer counts with original gene order
Approximate real library sizes, sparsity, detection and expression
Diversity comparable to real data; assess nearest-neighbor distances
baseline: Real training summaries and held-out-to-training nearest-neighbor distances supplied by evaluator
constraints: Evaluation split reserved for diagnostics, not tuning
next_action: Smoke-test then fixed 100-epoch count VAE and evaluate.
